name: Lady Meriwether
slug: Undead woman of the white dragon hoard, named Lady Meriwether.
description: Undead woman associated with the white dragon hoard. Dana names her Lady Meriwether from her notes on that hoard, and the table traces the name to Merryweather.

log.summary: While reading her notes from the white dragon hoard, Dana names the undead woman tied to it Lady Meriwether. The table traces the name to Merryweather.
